title: Quick Irish Oat Pudding
description: A simple and comforting dessert made with rolled oats, perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: 1. In a large saucepan, bring the water to a boil.
2. Add the salt and stir to dissolve.
4. Reduce the heat to medium and simmer, covered, for 5 minutes.
5. Remove from heat and stir in the pudding mix and butter until the mixture is smooth.
6. Return the saucepan to the heat and cook, stirring constantly, for an additional 2 minutes.
7. Remove from heat and stir in the cinnamon.
